title: Open Camping DB Commons do-not-match list
description: moderation/commons-do-not-match.json. Place and Commons file pairs that are not of the place, from travellers' reports. pipeline.commons never matches a listed pair again, and the release leaves it out.

pairs.description: Sorted by place, then file, each pair once.

file.description: The Commons file name, exactly as in commons/matches.ndjson: without File:.

added.description: Day the pair was added, YYYY-MM-DD.

source.description: Who decided: reports (two independent travellers reported the photo) or reviewer (the reviewer confirmed a single report). A person can remove a pair.
